featured_reviews.review_text:
Sheerdrive is a scam.   I had participated in an motorcycle auction for L & T finance repossessed  vehicles at Emerald yard, Iyyappanthangal, Chennai, almost two years ago on the 14th of March, 2023.  Although I was the highest bidder, I was not allotted the vehicle.  I had paid an amount of Rs.10,000/- as caution deposit for the bid.   I had also paid an amount of Rs.3,895/- as one year membership amount for participating in the auction.  At that time they had given me the used id: Userid-- SB110105H

A month later, on the 29th of April 2023, I have asked them to refund the deposit amount of Rs.10,000.  They tell me to email them through their website.  I have emailed them several times.  There is no acknowledgement and they do not refund the amount.  When I joined them, I did not send them a joining letter through email. So, now,  why do they want us to email?  I have sent them a request to their Chennai contact through whatsapp.  I have verbally told them over the phone to refund the amount several times.  What do they need more than that?  Since January, 2024, they have kept calling me to renew my membership.  I have told them to refund the amount of Rs.10,000/-,  Till date, they have not refunded the amount.

If you call their number, they do not answer or if they answer, they will say that they will call you back and never call back.

I have called the consumer number in L & T finance.  But they say, that they do not know anything about this matter of auction of repossessed vehicles.  One person who called himself as Manager, in L & T finance, had come for the auction, I had asked him for his number or office number, but he refused to give it to me, saying bidders should only contact sheerdrive to know the fate of their bid.   He thinks that he is the district magistrate.

When there are numerous complaints that sheerdrive is taking those vehicles and giving them away to other dealers or to dealers who could not come on that day for the auction, for a higher amount, why L & T finance is not having a way to convey to the bidders about their win?  They can even publish them in their website.  Maybe, their managers and others have some deal with sheerdrive and used vehicle dealers.

Do not ever participate in Sheerdrive auctions which is a scam to loot your deposit amount, plus the membership fee which is a waste of money.

I had also visited their auction yard later to know the fate of my deposit, where others told me, that sheerdrive never returns the deposits.  They steal them.

My question is why is L and T finance, acting in an irresponsible manner by dealing with scam websites like sheerdrive?  Also, why is the person who claims he is a manager not giving his phone number or his office phone number.  Is that the policy of L and T finance not to give phone numbers?

Prabakar,

After I posted a review, they wrote to me to tell me that I have to write to them that I am sick and cannot continue my business(what business it is I do not know) only then they will refund my money.  Why should I write to them that I am sick when I am not sick?
